newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian overnight rates narrow, one-week widen.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian overnight rates narrow, one-week widen.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed in a liquid private sector market on Tuesday to between 10 1/8 and 10 3/16 percent from Sunday's range of 10 1/8 and 10 1/4 percent, bankers said.
Bankers said there was no overnight borrowing on Monday due to expected liquidity later this week from T-bills maturing.
One-week rates widened to between 10 and 10 3/8 from 10 5/16 and 10 3/8 percent on Monday.
Public-sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
